title: •Zuckuss
caption: •Zuckuss (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. _Mist Hunter_ is maneuver +1. Your Black Sun agents at same and related sites may not have their forfeit reduced. Once per game, may ▼ non-{lightsaber} 4-LOM here. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Male Gand. Practitioner of ancient religious findsman vocation. Bounty hunter and scout. Gains surprisingly accurate information through mystical visions during meditation.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 4 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 4 (printed 4 / 3). Yellow (DS) pilot-power icon followed by '2.' → {pilot:2}; 'Mist Hunter' italic on the slip → _Mist Hunter_ (stub plain); the slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Inline icon in 'non-[black square, green blade] 4-LOM' → {lightsaber} per this run's instructions (STANDARD rev 8 calls this glyph the Permanent Weapon icon; the stub reads it as '[permanent pilot]' — stub differs). Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Alien (black disc with yellow eyes; printed icons Pilot, Warrior). The wiki's default 'Zuckuss' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Zuckuss (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). Dagobah-D-zuckuss.gif (349×489) is the errata face (E mark, 'anything he pilots' wording) — downloaded to src/vs7/22-Dagobah-D-zuckuss.gif for reference only; the 350×490 decipher-archive file is a square-on scan of the printed face (not a photo on a white page) and is used as art.src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright line legible: 1997 (Dagobah). Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded). V20-D-zuckuss.gif (745 px) is the later Virtual Set 20 Zuckuss, a different card — not used.
